eyebrow.zh: 国产模型 · per-span 兜底门
eyebrow.en: 国产模型 · per-span fallback gate

headline.zh: 没把握的一步，别再让模型硬编下去
headline.en: Stop letting your model barrel through the step it isn't sure of

sub.zh: 把模型每个 token 的真实评分和一次机器可校验的探针配对，只有两者同时亮红灯才把这一步交给人确认——探针真会触发、不确定度是你配上密钥后真去调模型读回来的，不是占位；每一步的判断还会写进本地日志，事后查得到。
sub.en: Pair the model's real per-token scores with a machine-checkable probe; route the step to a human only when both go red — the probes actually fire and, once you set your key, the uncertainty is fetched live from the model, not a placeholder. Every verdict is also written to a local log you can trace later.

scroll.en: See what it catches for you

title.zh: 只拦真正没把握的那一步
title.en: Halt only the step that's genuinely uncertain

body.zh: 单信号都不够：模型嘴上说没把握，或探针单独失败，都只是标记、不拦。只有「模型自报不确定 ∧ 探针真失败」同时出现，才把这一步交给人——其余全部放行。
body.en: Either signal alone is not enough: the model saying it's unsure, or a probe failing on its own, just flags the step. Only when self-reported uncertainty AND a failed probe fire together does the step go to a human — everything else proceeds.

chips: › 不确定度 + 探针 同时亮

title.zh: 它说会查的，就真的会查
title.en: What it says it checks, it really checks

body.zh: 一道兜底门最怕的不是漏报，是「号称会查、却静默放行」——那比不装还危险，给你假的安全感。现在每一项它承诺的检查都真触发：散落的 print 会被抓出来；schema 里说不认识的类型会直接报错，而不是装作「都验过了」；喂进来的怪格式 schema（该是列表却给了字符串、该是对象却给了列表），不会再崩成堆栈、也不会把字符串一个字一个字当成 key 报，而是明明白白告诉你格式不对。每一道检查都配一条回归测试盯着，装作没事的那类 bug 回不来。
body.en: A guardrail's worst failure isn't a miss — it's claiming to check something and then silently letting it through, which is worse than no guardrail because it hands you false confidence. Now every check it promises actually fires: a stray print gets flagged; an unknown schema type is surfaced instead of a fake 'all typed'; a malformed schema block (a list where an object was expected, a string where a list was) no longer crashes into a stack trace or mis-parses a string character-by-character as keys — it tells you plainly the shape is wrong. Every check ships with a regression test pinning it, so the 'pretend-it's-fine' class can't quietly come back.

chips: › 怪格式 schema 不崩不装

title.zh: 不确定度是真去查出来的，不是模型自报
title.en: The uncertainty is fetched, not the model's self-report

body.zh: 一道建在假数字上的门只是表演。所以不确定度不是模型嘴上说的那个数——你把 API 密钥和地址配一次，每一步都真去调一次模型，把每个 token 的评分读回来再算。这恰好是校准最弱的国产模型 serving 层最该有人兜着的地方；它从不单方定生死，只和探针做 AND 才出手。模型回的怪格式（不是预期的结构、字段缺了），不会再崩成一堆看不懂的堆栈、也不会装作没事，而是报一个名字清楚的错，你能看见、能接住；你在配置里填的密钥，每条命令、每个界面都会用上，不会被悄悄丢掉。就算模型那一下抽风（超时、报错、回了乱码）或你的 agent 本来就是异步跑的，门也不会跟着把整条跑死——它退回那条不单方定生死的老路继续走，而不是一崩到底。
body.en: A gate built on a made-up number is theater. So the uncertainty isn't the number the model just says — set the API key and endpoint once, and every step actually calls the model and reads back its per-token scores to compute the number. That's exactly the 国产模型 serving tier, where calibration is weakest and the signal most needs a human backing it; it never decides on its own, only AND-ed with a probe. A malformed response from the model (wrong shape, missing field) no longer crashes into an unreadable stack trace or fake-passes — it raises a plainly named error you can see and catch; the key you put in config is honored by every command and every screen, never silently dropped. And if the model hiccups that instant — a timeout, an error, a garbled response — or your agent runs async, the gate doesn't take the whole run down with it: it falls back to the path that never decides alone and keeps going, instead of crashing the loop.

chips: › 逐 token 算出不确定度
› 模型抽风不连累整条跑

title.zh: 每一步的判断，都白纸黑字记下来
title.en: Every verdict the gate makes is written down

body.zh: 门拦了哪一步、为什么拦、探针查出什么、模型有多没把握——每一次判断都追加进一个本地的日志文件，你可以随时打开查看、回溯到底哪一步出了岔。不上云、不收费、不碰那个团队付费的导出，就是一个你能随时翻看的本地文件。
body.en: Which step the gate stopped, why it stopped it, what the probe found, how unsure the model was — every verdict is appended to a local log file you can open anytime and trace exactly where things went sideways. No cloud, no paid export, no touching the team-tier relay — just a local file you can read whenever.

headline.zh: 给你的国产模型 agent 装一道真兜底门
headline.en: Give your 国产模型 agent a gate that actually catches

sub.zh: 一条命令装上，demo 里第 4 步就会弹门，每个判断都留痕可查。
sub.en: Install in one command — the demo trips the gate at step 4, and every verdict is logged for later.
